title: Metalic Block with Portuguese Emblem
detailed_description: The metal block has a distinctive design, featuring a square face that prominently displays the Portuguese emblem. This is likely intended to be visually striking and easily recognizable. The back of the block is semi-circular in shape, which suggests it was designed for attachment to a machine used for printing purposes. The semi-circular shape would allow for secure fixing to the machine. Two small spindles or spears are located at each corner of the square face, possibly serving as centring aids during the printing process. These features indicate that the block was designed with functionality and precision in mind.
